newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Nov 20.

text.p: U.S. airline American Airlines of AMR Corp plans to announce an order for "several hundred" new Boeing Co jets worth almost $6 billion to be delivered through 2020, the Wall Street Journal reported.

- Netscape Communications Corp is expected to announce that it will launch in the middle of next year software that will organize a computer desktop and make Microsoft Corp software just one of many programs inside.
- A former Texaco Inc official was charged with obstructing justice in the oil company's racial discrimination case.
- A U.S. federal judge has rejected a motion by Norfolk Southern Corp to prevent CSX Corp from buying Conrail Inc.
- U.S. banks will be able to enter a range of new businesses once the government announces changes to the sector's rules.
- Raising the minimum wage has not brought about the lay-offs many industry observers feared.
- New U.S. housing starts dropped 5.1 percent to an annual rate of 1.4 million units last month.
- Orange County's former treasurer was sentenced to one year in prison and fined $100,000.
- IBM Corp's shares rose five percent after a nine-percent climb during the previous three days. Its advance helped bring the Dow Jones Industrial Average 50.69 points up to 6,397.60.
- Dayton Hudson Corp, Limited Inc and AnnTaylor Stores Corp reported stronger fiscal third-quarter earnings.
- Sony Corp is considering ways to raise cash for its U.S. entertainment operations.
- Several hundred top Citicorp officials will likely share a more than $95-million windfall if the banks's stock does not fall in the next two weeks.
- Laptop computer makers cannot keep up with the demand for their products.
- U.S. bond prices rose on mundane economic indicator news despite a weak reception for $18.25 billion in new two-year notes.
